name: blit_omAlpha
source: var w=new Window(),d=new Layer(w,null),s=new Layer(w,d),r=[];var fs=[dfAlpha,dfOpaque,dfAddAlpha],as=[0,1,128,255],os=[0,1,128,255];for(var fi=0;fi<fs.count;fi++)for(var ai=0;ai<as.count;ai++)for(var bi=0;bi<as.count;bi++)for(var oi=0;oi<os.count;oi++)for(var hold=0;hold<2;hold++){var f=fs[fi],da=as[ai],sa=as[bi],o=os[oi];d.face=dfAlpha;d.fillRect(0,0,1,1,(da<<24)|0x204080);s.fillRect(0,0,1,1,(sa<<24)|0xe08030);d.face=f;d.holdAlpha=hold;d.imageModified=false;try{d.operateRect(0,0,s,0,0,1,1,omAlpha,o);r.add(d.getMainPixel(0,0)+':'+d.getMaskPixel(0,0)+':'+d.imageModified);}catch(e){r.add('error');}}return r.join('|');

name: blit_omAddAlpha
source: var w=new Window(),d=new Layer(w,null),s=new Layer(w,d),r=[];var fs=[dfAlpha,dfOpaque,dfAddAlpha],as=[0,1,128,255],os=[0,1,128,255];for(var fi=0;fi<fs.count;fi++)for(var ai=0;ai<as.count;ai++)for(var bi=0;bi<as.count;bi++)for(var oi=0;oi<os.count;oi++)for(var hold=0;hold<2;hold++){var f=fs[fi],da=as[ai],sa=as[bi],o=os[oi];d.face=dfAlpha;d.fillRect(0,0,1,1,(da<<24)|0x204080);s.fillRect(0,0,1,1,(sa<<24)|0xe08030);d.face=f;d.holdAlpha=hold;d.imageModified=false;try{d.operateRect(0,0,s,0,0,1,1,omAddAlpha,o);r.add(d.getMainPixel(0,0)+':'+d.getMaskPixel(0,0)+':'+d.imageModified);}catch(e){r.add('error');}}return r.join('|');

name: copy_faces
source: var w=new Window(),d=new Layer(w,null),s=new Layer(w,d),r=[];var fs=[dfAlpha,dfOpaque,dfAddAlpha,dfMask,dfProvince];for(var fi=0;fi<fs.count;fi++)for(var hold=0;hold<2;hold++){var f=fs[fi],da=64,sa=128;d.face=dfAlpha;d.fillRect(0,0,1,1,(da<<24)|0x204080);s.fillRect(0,0,1,1,(sa<<24)|0xe08030);d.face=f;d.holdAlpha=hold;d.imageModified=false;s.setProvincePixel(0,0,12);d.setProvincePixel(0,0,4);d.copyRect(0,0,s,0,0,1,1);r.add(d.getMainPixel(0,0)+':'+d.getMaskPixel(0,0)+':'+d.getProvincePixel(0,0));}return r.join('|');

name: blit_rows
source: var w=new Window(),d=new Layer(w,null),s=new Layer(w,d),r=[],modes=[omAlpha,omOpaque,omAddAlpha],fs=[dfAlpha,dfOpaque,dfAddAlpha];for(var mi=0;mi<3;mi++)for(var fi=0;fi<3;fi++)for(var hold=0;hold<2;hold++)for(var o=128;o<256;o+=127){d.face=dfAlpha;s.face=dfAlpha;d.fillRect(0,0,12,2,0x80402010);s.fillRect(0,0,12,2,0x8000ffff);s.fillRect(0,0,3,2,0xff204080);d.face=fs[fi];d.holdAlpha=hold;d.operateRect(1,0,s,0,0,10,2,modes[mi],o);var hash=0;for(var y=0;y<2;y++)for(var x=0;x<12;x++)hash=(hash*65599+d.getMainPixel(x,y)+d.getMaskPixel(x,y))&0x7fffffff;r.add(hash);}return r.join('|');
